kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS CPU = MAX(IRATE(metrics.node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total)), Mem = MAX(IRATE(metrics.node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total)), IO = MAX(IRATE(metrics.node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(20, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS CPU = MAX(CPU), Mem = MAX(Mem), IO = MAX(IO)
| EVAL __labels = MV_APPEND(MV_APPEND("CPU", "I/O"), "Mem"), __values = MV_APPEND(MV_APPEND(COALESCE(TO_STRING(CPU), ""), COALESCE(TO_STRING(IO), "")), COALESCE(TO_STRING(Mem), ""))
| EVAL __pairs = MV_ZIP(__labels, __values, "\t")
| MV_EXPAND __pairs
| EVAL label = MV_FIRST(SPLIT(__pairs, "\t")), gauge_value = TO_DOUBLE(MV_LAST(SPLIT(__pairs, "\t"))) * 100
| KEEP label, gauge_value
| SORT label ASC
